[P2] Unhandled exception from Result.getOrThrow() in _startOrOpenChat

_startOrOpenChat calls existingResult.getOrThrow() (line 575) and createResult.getOrThrow() (line 582) without a try-catch block. If findConversation or createConversation fails (e.g., network error, server error), the thrown AppException propagates unhandled — the user sees no feedback, navigation does not occur, and the error surfaces as an unhandled exception in the zone. Other async methods in the same file (_updateStatus at line 606, _renewReport at line 695) properly wrap their repository calls in try-catch with user-facing error toasts, making this omission inconsistent.

[P2] CachedNetworkImage receives video URLs instead of image thumbnails

_buildVideoList (line 752) iterates report.videoUrls and passes each URL to CachedNetworkImage (line 767). CachedNetworkImage is designed for image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and will fail to decode video file URLs (MP4, MOV). The errorWidget renders a solid gray container, so every video tile appears as a blank gray box with only a play-button overlay — no visual thumbnail preview is ever shown.

[P3] TextEditingController mutated as a side-effect inside build method

The build method (line 88) directly calls _contactPhoneController.text = authState.phone! (line 98) to auto-fill the contact phone. Flutter's build phase should be pure and side-effect-free; mutating a TextEditingController here can trigger listener callbacks during layout and leads to fragile ordering dependencies. Additionally, if authState.hasPhone is true but phone were somehow null the null-assertion would crash. The initialization should be moved to initState or a post-frame callback.

[P3] Negative duration display in _timeAgo when lastSeenAt is in the future

_timeAgo (line 25) computes DateTime.now().difference(dateTime). If report.lastSeenAt is in the future (clock skew, stale data, or test data), the resulting Duration is negative, and diff.inMinutes/hours/days are negative. The UI would display strings like "-5 минутын өмнө" which are nonsensical. The same pattern exists in lost_horse_card.dart:_timeAgo (line 17). A simple abs() or clamp to zero would prevent misleading output.
